3.4.7: Cars: the slowest speed setting now moves the car instead of stopping it, and a held stick reaches full speed instead of crawling — the speed floor and the soft-start ramp were both eating the demand.
Cars: during a router switch the OLED names the router it is joining and counts the seconds it has been trying, so a slow switch is no longer indistinguishable from one that never happened.
Reset car: the panel now clears the holding values (speed, servo, steer limit, trim, mode, status) and shows the boot defaults, instead of keeping the last values until each control was nudged.
Google sign-in says plainly when the build is missing its Google config instead of surfacing a raw SDK error.
3.4.6: The app's OLED mirror carries the same car identity and transport rows the 4WD4M / 2WD1M firmware paints.
3.4.5: Bug fixes and quality improvements across the cars, D-pad, status bar and admin screens.
3.4.4: Remote: the D-pad stays when the car connects, the status note no longer resizes the drive deck, and the control tabs read as one strip.
Cars: the 4WD4M no longer resets at the start of a cycle; the 2WD1M remembers its steering, trim and telemetry and can switch to another router.
Each car is identified by its project (4wd4mcar / 2wd1mcar) and shown once per device, not once per connection key.
Admin: the Users tab no longer duplicates cars, and each account has its own Cars, Preferences and Activity windows.
3.4.3: Fully native rebuild: native UI, native auth, shared Supabase data, in-app updates.
